title.en: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS THREE AND NINE OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE AND SECTION FOUR OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT ACT, SO FAR AS CONCERNS THE PROVINCE OF ORIENTAL NEGROS.

text.en:
Sections three and nine of the Municipal Code are hereby amended as follows:
(a) By adding at the close of section three of said Act the following words: "In the Province of
Oriental Negros, the seats of the councilors of the first class, as divided by lot, shall for the year
nineteen hundred and two be vacated on the first day of April, nineteen hundred and two, or when
their successors are duly chosen and qualified. "
(b) By adding at the close of paragraph (a), section nine, of said Act the following words: "In the
Province of Oriental Negros, the general municipal elections for nineteen hundred and two shall be
held on Saturday, the first of March, nineteen hundred and two, and the councilors so elected shall
enter upon their duties on the first of April following and hold office until the first Monday of January,
nineteen hundred and four, or until their successors are duly elected and qualified. "

Section four of the Provincial Government Act is hereby amended by adding at the close thereof
the following words: "In the Province of Oriental Negros the elections for provincial governor for nineteen
hundred and two shall be held on Tuesday, the third of April, nineteen hundred and two. "

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 25, 1902.
